mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (id, user_id, token, expires_at, revoked, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{token}, #{expiresAt}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token, expires_at, revoked, created_at FROM refresh_token WHERE token = #{token} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked = 0
